items.item_text: Bachelors degree in Psychology, Social Work, Public Health, Counseling, or related behavioral health field
Master’s degree + license as a mental health professional
Minimum 1 year of supervisory experience in a mental/behavioral health setting
3+ years experience providing technical assistance, implementation support, or quality improvement services

Minimum 1 year of experience providing technical assistance, training, consultation, coaching, quality improvement, or implementation support to behavioral health, community-based, or human services programs
Experience supporting individuals with serious mental illness, co-occurring disorders, homelessness, or other complex behavioral health needs
Experience with program evaluation, fidelity reviews, quality improvement initiatives, or data-informed performance monitoring

The Public Mental Health Partnership (PMHP) within the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior at UCLA serves as a California Center of Excellence supporting Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) and Forensic ACT (FACT) programs through training, consultation, evaluation, and quality improvement efforts.

We are seeking a Behavioral Health Technical Assistance Supervisor to lead statewide technical assistance activities supporting ACT and FACT programs throughout California. This role will supervise a team of trainers, guide technical assistance strategy, and collaborate with program leaders, fidelity reviewers, and external partners to strengthen implementation of evidence-based behavioral health practices. Key responsibilities:
Supervise, coach, develop, and evaluate technical assistance and training staff
Lead technical assistance strategies that support ACT and FACT teams in improving program implementation and quality of care
Translate fidelity review findings, program data, and quality improvement results into actionable training and consultation plans
Develop recommendations and resources that support statewide implementation goals and evidence-based practices
Collaborate with PMHP leadership, trainers, fidelity reviewers, and external partners to coordinate technical assistance initiatives
Prepare written reports, recommendations, and presentations for leadership, providers, and other stakeholders
Travel: Occasional travel to the UCLA campus and program sites throughout California may be required.

Demonstrated knowledge of community-based behavioral health service models like ACT, FACT, Full Service Partnership (FSP), Housing First, Critical Time Intervention (CTI), Intensive Case Management (ICM), or related programs
Ability to analyze complex clinical and program information and translate findings into practical recommendations
Strong written, communication, presentation, stakeholder engagement, and relationship-building skills
